card.name: The start of "contraindicated"
card.fires_on: The first piece "contr" of the word "contraindicated" after "is" or "also", in drug-label contraindication statements. It also fires weakly on "may" in a statement about mixing two drugs.

modes.label: contr in contraindicated
modes.description: The opening piece of "contraindicated" after "is" in a statement that a drug or vaccine should not be used in a group of patients.

modes.label: may before be administered
modes.description: The word "may" in a statement that two products can be given together.
modes.example: bupivacaine HCl and bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension<< may>> be administered simultaneously in the same syringe

card.writes: It promotes odd word pieces and suppresses words for "forbidden" and "prohibited" in several languages, so it points toward a ban-like word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label begins to say "contraindicated", meaning the drug must not be used.
